# Fig 3D

Inner mitochondrial membrane (IMM) surface area in reconstructed juxtaspinal mitochondrial regions.

**Source data**  
`Fig 3D, E.csv`

**Columns**

- `Date` — Experiment date
- `Condition` — Control or TTX
- `Mito` — Mitochondrial reconstruction ID
- `IMM_surf_um2` — Inner mitochondrial membrane surface area (µm²)

## Data

```{r fig-3d-data}
condition_order <- c("Control", "TTX")
spacing_map <- c("Control" = 1, "TTX" = 2.2)

Density <- read_csv("./Fig 3D, E.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(Condition %in% condition_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = condition_order),
    Date = factor(trimws(as.character(Date))),
    IMM_surf_um2 = as.numeric(IMM_surf_um2),
    x_pos = unname(spacing_map[as.character(Condition)]),
    color_key = paste(Condition, Date, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(IMM_surf_um2))

if (nrow(Density) == 0) stop("No valid observations remain.")

Density %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

## Summary

```{r fig-3d-summary}
summary_table <- Density %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_Mitochondria = n(),
    n_Experiment_Dates = n_distinct(Date),
    `Mean (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(IMM_surf_um2), sd(IMM_surf_um2) / sqrt(n())),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_table
```

## Statistics

Two-way ANOVA with condition, experiment date, and their interaction (Type I sums of squares).

```{r fig-3d-statistics}
fit_aov <- aov(IMM_surf_um2 ~ Condition * Date, data = Density)
anova_table <- anova(fit_aov)
condition_p <- as.numeric(anova_table["Condition", "Pr(>F)"])
format_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.0001, "<0.0001", sprintf("%.4f", p))

group_means <- Density %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(IMM_surf_um2), SE = sd(IMM_surf_um2) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

stats_table <- tibble(
  Test = "Two-way ANOVA",
  Comparison = "Control vs TTX",
  `Control mean (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", group_means$mean[1], group_means$SE[1]),
  `TTX mean (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", group_means$mean[2], group_means$SE[2]),
  `Condition p` = format_p(condition_p)
)

stats_table
```

## Plot

```{r fig-3d-plot, fig.width=18, fig.height=24, fig.retina=1, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}
set.seed(20261109)
p_to_stars <- function(p) case_when(
  p < 0.0001 ~ "****", p < 0.001 ~ "***",
  p < 0.01 ~ "**", p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"
)

test_results <- tibble(
  group1_x = spacing_map["Control"],
  group2_x = spacing_map["TTX"],
  y_position = 4.5,
  stars = p_to_stars(condition_p)
) %>%
  filter(stars != "ns")

date_levels <- levels(Density$Date)

date_colors <- c(
  setNames(rep(c("#1A1A1A", "#4D4D4D", "#6F7C80"), length.out = length(date_levels)),
           paste("Control", date_levels, sep = "_")),
  setNames(rep(c("#8A5700", "#FFB703", "#C5B358"), length.out = length(date_levels)),
           paste("TTX", date_levels, sep = "_"))
)

fig3d_plot <- ggplot(Density, aes(x_pos, IMM_surf_um2, color = color_key)) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(cex = 8, priority = "random", size = 30,
                            alpha = 1, corral = "random") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = x_pos), fill = NA, width = 1, outlier.shape = NA,
               linewidth = 2, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(aes(group = x_pos), fun = mean, geom = "point",
               shape = 15, size = 30, color = "black") +
  geom_segment(data = test_results,
               aes(x = group1_x, xend = group2_x, y = y_position, yend = y_position),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 2, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = test_results,
            aes(x = (group1_x + group2_x) / 2, y = y_position + 0.1, label = stars),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 35, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unname(spacing_map),
                     labels = c("control", "homeostatic\nplasticity")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = date_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(oob = scales::oob_keep, breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4), limits = c(0, 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "", y = expression(IMM~surface~area~group("(", mu*m^2, ")"))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 80, color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 80, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 5, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 2, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

fig3d_plot
```

```{r fig-3d-save, include=FALSE}
dir.create("./Graphs", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

output_file <- "./Graphs/Fig 3D.png"

ggsave(output_file, fig3d_plot, width = 18, height = 24, units = "in", dpi = 300)

tibble(Figure = "Fig 3D", File = output_file)
```

# Fig 3F

Number of crista junctions within each reconstructed juxtaspinal mitochondrial region.

**Source data**  
`Fig 3D, E.csv`, `Fig 3F.csv`

**Columns**

- `Date` — Experiment date
- `Condition` — Control or TTX
- `Mito` — Mitochondrial reconstruction ID
- `Junction_ID` — Crista junction ID

## Data

Distinct junctions are counted per reconstruction. Reconstructions with no junctions contribute a count of zero.

```{r fig-3f-data}
condition_order <- c("Control", "TTX")
spacing_map <- c("Control" = 1, "TTX" = 2.2)

reconstructions <- read_csv("./Fig 3D, E.csv", show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  distinct(Date,Condition,Mito) %>% filter(Condition %in% condition_order)
junction_counts <- read_csv("./Fig 3F.csv",show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  filter(Condition %in% condition_order,!is.na(Date),!is.na(Mito),!is.na(Junction_ID)) %>%
  distinct(Date,Condition,Mito,Junction_ID) %>% count(Date,Condition,Mito,name="CJ_count")
Density <- reconstructions %>% left_join(junction_counts,by=c("Date","Condition","Mito")) %>%
  mutate(CJ_count=coalesce(CJ_count,0L),Condition=factor(Condition,levels=condition_order),
         Date=factor(trimws(as.character(Date))),Mito=as.character(Mito),
         x_pos=unname(spacing_map[as.character(Condition)]),color_key=paste(Condition,Date,sep="_"))

if (nrow(Density) == 0) stop("No valid observations remain.")

Density %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

## Summary

```{r fig-3f-summary}
summary_table <- Density %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_Mitochondria = n(),
    n_Experiment_Dates = n_distinct(Date),
    `Mean (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(CJ_count), sd(CJ_count) / sqrt(n())),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_table
```

# Fig 3H
